# VRV Global

VRV Global Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based commodity trading and integrated supply chain company.

## Business Summary
VRV Global operates across agro commodities, natural rubber, block rubber / TSR, industrial metals, mining ventures, circular economy materials, and strategic supply chain ventures.

The company focuses on responsible sourcing, traceability, sustainable supply chains, commodity trade execution, and long-term partnerships.
